userStories.title: Delete the fix strategies
userStories.description:
**Goal** — Remove the fourteen unreachable fix-strategy/declaration modules and their exports while moving retained tool-declaration guards to live workflow operations.

**Motivation** — The fix strategies and TDD session operations were dispatched only by the story orchestrator and its stages, deleted in B2b-1.

**Approach** — Design Part 1: the fix strategies (US-001)

| Site | After |
|:---|:---|
| `operations/index.ts:1`, `:10-22`, `:45-46`, `:62-64`, `:71-90`, `:106-107`, `:112-113`, `:131-132` | the re-exports of `_finding-to-check`, `apply-test-edit-declarations`, `autofix-implementer`, `autofix-implementer-strategy`, `autofix-test-writer`, `autofix-test-writer-strategy`, `declaration-sink`, `full-suite-rectify`, `full-suite-rectify-op`, `mechanical-formatfix-strategy`, `mechanical-lintfix-strategy`, `rectify`, `test-edit-declaration` and `validate-mock-structure-files` go |
| `config/selectors.ts` | `autofixConfigSelector` (`:101`), `AutofixConfig` (`:176`) and `NbfWorthCheckConfig` (`:179`) go, with imports only they used |
| `config/index.ts:187` | `autofixConfigSelector` leaves the `./selectors` re-export |
| `prompts/builders/rectifier-builder-helpers.ts` | `REPO_SCOPE_MANDATE` (`:475`) and `repoScopedRectification` (`:505`) go, with their doc comments |
| `prompts/index.ts:84` | the `repoScopedRectification` re-export goes |
| `scripts/check-worktree-id-ssot.ts:83` | unchanged in US-001; US-002 removes this entry |

Deleted, under `operations/`: `_finding-to-check.ts`, `apply-test-edit-declarations.ts`, `autofix-implementer.ts`, `autofix-implementer-strategy.ts`, `autofix-test-writer.ts`, `autofix-test-writer-strategy.ts`, `declaration-sink.ts`, `full-suite-rectify.ts`, `full-suite-rectify-op.ts`, `mechanical-formatfix-strategy.ts`, `mechanical-lintfix-strategy.ts`, `rectify.ts`, `test-edit-declaration.ts`, `validate-mock-structure-files.ts`.

The four kept tests that list Bash-, Delete- or Write-declaring operations by name (`bash-declarations.test.ts`, `tool-declarations.test.ts`, `inert-bash-stages.test.ts`, `check-bash-dispatch-ask.test.ts`) are rewritten once, in this story, to name live operations, so US-002 does not edit them again. The live operations that declare Bash are `workflowImplementOp`, `workflowBranchFixOp` and `workflowRepairOp` (stage `run`) and `workflowStoryReviewOp`, `workflowReReviewOp`, `workflowBranchReviewOp` and `botPrReviewOp` (stage `review`). `BASH_DECLARING_STAGES` (`config/inert-bash-stages.ts:50`) stays `["run", "review", "rectification", "acceptance"]`: no live operation dispatches on `rectification` or `acceptance` any more, and both strings stay registry members until wave B3, as `acceptance` already does.

**Scope** — In: the above source cuts, obsolete tests, retained guard migrations, related stale comments and downward baseline updates. Out: US-002's TDD operation removal, TDD selector and marker parser; US-003's fix cycle; US-004's TDD directory and verification leaves; US-005's acceptance/prompt leaves. Keep the verify.ts scanned-file entry until US-002. Do not alter workflow operations, permission resolution, name registries or BASH_DECLARING_STAGES values.

**Interface** — Existing read-only seams: `findInertBashStages(config)` and `BASH_DECLARING_STAGES` (`config/inert-bash-stages.ts`); `bashCarryingNames(mod)` (`scripts/check-bash-dispatch-ask.ts`). No new externally-visible symbol.

**Test migration and deletion** — Paths below are package-relative. Delete these files under test/unit/operations/: apply-test-edit-declarations.test.ts, autofix-implementer.test.ts, autofix-implementer-strategy.test.ts, autofix-test-writer.test.ts, autofix-test-writer-strategy.test.ts, fix-strategy-composition.test.ts, full-suite-rectify.test.ts, full-suite-rectify-op.test.ts, mechanical-formatfix-strategy.test.ts, mechanical-lintfix-strategy.test.ts, rectify.test.ts, test-edit-declaration.test.ts, validate-mock-structure-files.test.ts, finding-to-check.test.ts and call-acceptance-guidance.test.ts. Each only exercises the removed modules/composition. In test/unit/operations/bash-declarations.test.ts use workflowImplementOp, workflowBranchFixOp and workflowRepairOp for Bash-capable rows; remove verifier from never-Bash rows, retaining plan. In test/unit/operations/tool-declarations.test.ts use workflowImplementOp and workflowBranchFixOp for FILE_MUTATING_OPS, preserving Write/Edit/Delete/Git assertions; remove verifier from read-only rows, retaining plan. In test/unit/config/inert-bash-stages.test.ts list all seven live Bash ops; RETAINED_REGISTRY_STAGES becomes [acceptance, rectification], with comments saying neither has a live dispatcher; update the six-operations wording without changing other assertions. Its regression guard must inspect every exported operation value with Bash, not merely a handpicked subset. In test/unit/scripts/check-bash-dispatch-ask.test.ts replace the real-barrel #2201/factory case with 'the real barrel: the workflow write ops are Bash-carrying', asserting the three workflow write names and excluding classifyRouteOp. In test/unit/prompts/rectifier-builder.test.ts remove only the repoScopedRectification describe, its comment block and its repoScopedRectification/Finding imports; retain RectifierPromptBuilder assertions. Remove unused imports and lower complexity, escape-hatch, coverage and file-size baselines as applicable; do not run coverage inside nax. Comments that name a deleted symbol rather than its path, which the sweep cannot find and which are reworded too: `test/helpers/op-model.ts:22`, `test/helpers/runtime.ts:67`, `operations/build-hop-callback-dispatch.ts:97`, `operations/mutation-check.ts:9`, `context/greenfield.ts:170` and `:175`, `pipeline/stages/routing.ts:149`, `prompts/core/sections/prior-failures.ts:5`, `plugins/builtin/curator/heuristics.ts:102`, `scripts/check-op-tool-capability.ts:20`, and in tests `pipeline/greenfield.test.ts:41-45`, `:82` and `:122`, `prompts/core/sections/prior-failures.test.ts:4`, `scripts/check-op-tool-capability.test.ts:20` and the `findings/story-fix-history.test.ts` header (`:1-17`).

Verification, run in packages/nax: (1) bun run typecheck. (2) Path sweep: for each source file this story deletes, with <stem> its path below src/ without the extension, run rg -n --fixed-strings '<stem>' src bin test scripts ../repo-tooling/scripts ../repo-tooling/test, and the same for each deleted test file's path below test/; expected zero hits. A hit in code, in a test that reads a source file by path, or in a path list a test or script iterates is a missed reference: stop. A hit in a comment is a stale comment and is reworded. Expected and not a stop: the tdd config keys and three-session-tdd strings; the absence assertions in test/integration/prompts/pb-004-migration.test.ts; hits in scripts/baselines/*.json; the rectification-loop*.test.ts entries in scripts/check-inline-test-mocks.ts (:75, :77, :138, :139); the "src/tdd/x.ts" string in ../repo-tooling/test/unit/scripts/check-git-spawn-env.test.ts:185. A longer sibling stem is not a hit (kept siblings: operations/verify-scoped, findings/cycle-types). Line numbers are at a5f470b20; after an earlier story edited a file, locate each site by symbol or test name. (3) bun run check:complexity:update; bun run check:file-sizes -- --update-baseline when it reports a lowerable entry; after check:all is green, bun run check:test-escape-hatches:update; remove entries for deleted source files from scripts/baselines/coverage-per-file-baseline.json by hand, and do not run test:coverage. (4) bun run check:all and bun run test.

**Motivation** — Their last production references are the barrels (`packages/nax/src/operations/index.ts`, `src/tdd/index.ts`).

This refinement explicitly requested negative-path ACs for every story, so add two existing-behavior regression assertions, not new production features: US-003's fresh Map returns undefined for a missing key; US-005's unsupported framework falls back to the quote-joined Bun command.
